lines: 「Man, school days are so lazy, fresh off a break......」
Gosha Academy, the first day after summer break.
Today was just the opening ceremony, so school ended in the morning.
Hebiko sat across from me, the day's set lunch in hand. Today's special was fried shrimp.
「That's not true. For starters, even during summer break, I've been coming to school for remedial lessons, and training, and stuff......」
Having finished eating ahead of her, I pushed aside my plate of summer-exclusive chilled Chinese noodles, and slumped over the table.
「Oi, oi, Fuuma! If you're gonna sleep there, there's no room for me!」
Shikanosuke forcibly shoved my arm out of the way with his tray, which had a large serving of the yakisoba-tenshinhan special on it.
「Fuuma may be dependable during missions, but at school he's the same as ever, eh? All right, let's eat!」
「A big serving, when it's this hot? You guys sure eat a lot, considering you're so tiny......」
「That's right, Fuuma-chan. As a Taimanin, it's vital Hebiko eats a lot to build up her strength!」
Saying that, the two of them chowed down ravenously on their set meals.
（Now that I've seen that, I've gotten hungry again too. Should I buy a yakisoba sandwich or something? Nah, my allowance is tight already......）
While I was thinking things like that, the two of them quickly finished eating their lunches, and
With that, they stood up to go somewhere.
「Mmm? School ends here today, doesn't it? Where're you going?」
「We've been asked to do something by Tokiko-sensei.」
「Once we're done, she's going to buy us some Inageya ice cream! Are you coming too, Fuuma-chan?」
Hearing “Inageya ice cream”, I was tempted for a moment, but...
「Unfortunately, I have business with Shuka-senpai after this.」
Hebiko made her eyes light up.
「Hebiko was put in a joint class with her once, and it was like, “Wow!” There were a whole lot of things for Hebiko to learn from her.」
Shuka-senpai was an outstanding student Taimanin, equally as promising as Yukikaze or Rinko-senpai.
「――What business do you have with that Shuka-senpai? Could it be that you're going to ask her to join the Independent Commando Unit?!」
「No, no, that's not it. I just had a little something I wanted to ask her.」
「Oi, Hebiko, we gotta go now, you know?!」
「Ah, you're right. Bye, Fuuma-chan. Give Hebiko's regards to Shuka-senpai, okay?」
The two of them hurriedly tidied up their dishes, and then left the cafeteria like the wind.
「Sorry to keep you waiting, Fuuma. What did you want with me?」
A corridor lined with classrooms for students in higher grades.
Not long ago, I used to get nervous every time I came here and felt my senpais' eyes on me, but after coming by frequently, I had gotten completely used to it.
That appeared to go for my seniors as well, as even though I, an underclassman, was conversing with Shuka-senpai, nobody paid me any mind anymore.
「I want you to tell me about Gaiza.」
「Of the Nisha? You'd be a lot more knowledgable than me, wouldn't you?」
Shuka-senpai asked back with a puzzled expression, narrowing her brightly-coloured eyes.
「Certainly, the Nisha are one of my...... the Fuuma's clans, but there's lots of stuff I wouldn't know, precisely because I'm too close to them.」
「A short time before the rebellion incident, I saw Gaiza talking to Senpai.」
「It was rare for that guy to strike up a conversation with a female senpai, after all.」
Shuka-senpai made a face that said, “I see.”
（All else aside, those are some beautiful eyes......）
My gaze couldn't help but be drawn to them.
Her brightly-coloured eyes, which were different on each side, were sparkling like jewels adorning her porcelain skin.
Shuka-senpai was the owner of an Evil Eye ability, which was rare outside the Fuuma family.
For that reason, I had been well aware of the existence of this senpai for some time, but this was the first time we had spoken up close like this.
（Because somehow, I didn't use to like this senpai much before......）
Possessing striking looks and a powerful Evil Eye, Shuka-senpai was a talented type with a highly-anticipated future.
On the other hand, there was me, the “Diot”, who, despite being the head of the Fuuma, had no powers at all, let alone an Evil Eye.
Though I had been feeling one-sidedly inferior to Shuka-senpai because of that, conversely, I had also been strongly aware of her.
（However, now's not the time to be seized by that inferiority complex.）
To enter a battle, you must know your enemy, and yourself.
While investigating my own ability, I had been collecting information on Gaiza as well, and remembered that he had spoken with Shuka-senpai prior to the revolt.
「You say strike up a conversation, but it wasn't really like that, you know? We only talked for a little bit......」
「Let me see...... It was questions about my Evil Eye.」
「When did I awaken to my Evil Eye, how did I become aware of my own abilities, and so on.」
「It was about awakening to your Evil Eye......?」
A complex bitterness ran through my mind.
（Could it be...... that Gaiza was hoping there was a chance my Evil Eye would awaken until the very end......?）
（The odds are higher that he was planning the rebellion, and gathering information in aid of better mastering his own abilities.）
Shuka stared at me curiously as I chewed up and swallowed that bitter pill.
「I suppose he was interested because Evil Eye owners are rare outside the Fuuma clan. You're an Evil Eye user too, right?」
「Well, it does happen every now and again that someone within a family awakens to a Ninja Art from a different bloodline.」
「I understand there's a theory that the manifestation of Taimanin abilities is a kind of atavism.」
「So if we assume that's true, it's not all that strange, no matter what ability anybody awakens to.」
I was keeping silent for a while, wonder how to explain myself, when
「Here you are, Lord-sama. There's a little something I want to ask of you.」
The one who had called out to me was Tokiko, who was both my older sister and my steward, as well as a teacher at school.
「Tokiko-sensei! Come to think of it, Fuuma is Sensei's little brother, isn't he?」
Tokiko smiled at Shuka, and then turned back towards me.
「The thing is, I asked Hebiko-chan and Shikanosuke-kun to tidy up the gym storeroom, but they haven't come back......」
「I guess it was too hard for just two people after all. I have remedial classes after this, so could you please go and help them out for me, Lord-sama?」
I had been planning to go straight home and relax as soon as I was done hearing what Shuka-senpai had to say.
「If you'll go for me, then Lord-sama will also......」
「Get Inageya ice cream, right? I'm not so easy that I'd be enticed just by......」
「And in addition, a one-hour extension of your gaming time today.」
I did hesitate for a moment, but when I heard that she would increase my gaming time in addition to the Inageya ice cream, I had no reason not to do it.
It already felt like I was being left in the dust by Sakura the Slacker these days.
「Could Ootori-san go as well? There's ice cream in it for you, of course.」
「Yes. I have nothing after this today, so I'll lend a hand.」
「Murasaki-sensei was searching for some line powder. If you find any in the storehouse, please deliver it to her.」
「It's a white powder used when drawing white lines on the ground.」
While thinking “I didn't know it had a name like that” in my mind, I headed to the storeroom with Shuka-senpai.
Going through the gym was a shorter way to the rear yard, where the PE storeroom was.
When Shuka-senpai and I entered the gymnasium, a fiery voice rang out.
When I looked there, some Gosha Animal Taimanin, as well as Yukikaze, Clear and the Yatagarasu child, were lined up in front of Sakura-sensei.
「What kind of an assortment is that?」
They looked to all appearances like the Happy Friends of the Forest, but Sakura-sensei was addressing them with a serious face. (TL: Characters from the Sylvanian Families/Calico Cats toy line.)
「I've gathered you all today for one reason only.」
「I've had reports that the Animal Taimanin, which should only be tame for me, have been obeying other people recently. Do you have any idea why?」
The five people...... uhh, critters, rather, shook their heads, flapped their wings, wagged their tails, etc. in unison.
「I'd hardly believe it, but you guys haven't been feeding them, or getting fed, riiight?」
「And you haven't, say, witnessed any situation like that?」
Sakura-sensei looked over the whole group, who averted their eyes as they denied it.
「Listen up. These guys have a vital duty to protect Gosha.」
「It's off limits for them to get friendly with anyone without authorization, much less become their minions. Do you understand?」
「Hmmm. Then all of you shut your eyes!」
「I'm going to ask this just one more time, all right? I won't get angry, so point to the person who vassalized the Animal Taimanin!」
However, the five critters (?) didn't move an inch. They had a strange bond, didn't they?
Dumbfounded by viewing that scene, Shuka opened her mouth.
「Who knows? Maybe it's a new game......」
「I guess. Anyway, it looks like Sakura-sensei's there...... And so are some weird creatures for some reason......」
「F-For now, c'mon, we've gotta go clean up the storeroom!」
It would be a pain to pry too deeply. I urged Shuka-senpai on, and headed to the rear yard, where the PE storehouse was.
The door to the PE storehouse, which was rarely used, made a weighty metallic sound when it moved.

Objects that were hard to find a place for (antiquated sports equipment, cultural festival signs, etc.) were abandoned haphazardly within, and, with a characteristic smell, it was filled with enough dust to be visible to the eye.
「This will be tough to clean up with two people, won't it? Let's get this over with quickly.」
Shuka-senpai said, and promptly began to tidy the floor.
A bag of line powder was lying around behind the mat that Shuka-senpai had easily lifted up.
「I'm sorry, by the way, making Senpai help...」
「Don't worry about it. Cleaning is good training. This is for my own sake, too.」
Shuka-senpai seemed to have a stoic, serious personality which didn't match her vibrant appearance.
「Besides, I've been thinking I'd like to talk with Hebiko some more.」
「We worked together in class once, and her ability is interesting.」
「――Speaking of which, where did Hebiko and Shikanosuke go?」
The storehouse had been unlocked, but there was no sign of the two of them inside.
「I wonder if they went to the bathroom with upset stomachs? Maybe I'll eat three people's worth of ice cream.」
“They both ate a ton of lunch, after all”――The instant I was about to say that.
「Greedy as ever! Well, it's typical for Fuuma, though.」
Where had they been? Hebiko and Shikanosuke had suddenly come into view.
「Oh, there you were. I'm joking, obviously.」
「Yeah. Fuuma-chan always makes us fight, and does nothing but watch, yet he takes all the credit for himself, doesn't he?」
「That's the kind of guy Fuuma is, after all!」
The two of them giggled amusedly as they dissed me for some reason.
「You're sure being pretty hard on me today.」
Anyhow, it was good the two of them were here. Now our cleaning would get somewhere.
「That sorta stuff's why he got betrayed by Gaiza, right?!」
「For sure. He's nothing but big-headed and bossy. Ohhh, perhaps Hebiko should have gone to Gaiza-chan's side too.」
The pair's insults knew no end. They were just saying whatever they wanted to.
Had I somehow done something to anger them both? I thought back on my words and actions a short time ago.
（They were normal in the cafeteria. I mean, I was joking around and stuff, but that's usual, and it was tit-for-tat......）
Shuka-senpai, who was standing at my side before I knew it, whispered with a serious face.
「These guys are always odd. Well, they're odder than usual today, though.」
「When we came into this room, there was no sign of people whatsoever.」
「I said, right? “They're nowhere to be found.”」
I hadn't been able to catch her meaning for a moment, but I could tell that something wasn't normal.
（Certainly, where the hell were they hiding, in this room, which isn't that big......?）
And the air I sensed from the two of them was somehow different from usual.
「Or illusions. Either way, it's certain that something's strange.」
Having heard those words, Hebiko and Shikanosuke guffawed.
「That's right! What're you saying's odd about us?」
No sooner had they said that than――the figures of the pair disappeared into a black mist.
And then――Within the mist, a large broken mirror appeared.
「What's this? Was this thing here before?!」
The mirror was giving off a strange, evil aura. The scene on this side wasn't reflected in its surface.
Also, the black mist-like stuff was swirling around it, and, moreover, leaking out and enveloping it.
I moved a step closer to try and peer into the mirror.
At which point, all of a sudden, the thick mist spread larger and enveloped my body.
Shuka-senpai's hand reached out amid the darkness. I grasped it desperately.
「Shuka-senpai too?! You two got sucked in here as well?!」
The next thing I knew, I was in a place with black mist swirling around. In front of my eyes were Hebiko and Shikanosuke.
「You?! What did you do to me?!」
「Fuuma-chan touched the mirror in the gym storeroom too, didn't he?」
「......? Are you guys the real you......?」
I was instantly on my guard, but the two of them seemed like the usual Hebiko and Shikanosuke.
「Yeah! We were tidying up the storehouse like Tokiko-sensei asked us to, but......」
「Oh, you're right. That's dangerous. Let's take it out of here. Help Hebiko out, Shikanosuke-chan.」
「Gotcha. All right, I'll take this side.」
「Whoa?! What's this?! Hebiko, did you spit out your octopus ink?!」
「And just like that, the moment we tried to lift the mirror, we were enshrouded by black mist, and the next thing we knew, we were here.」
「It's the same for us, right, Shuka-senpai? ......Shuka-senpai?」
And then, something moved restlessly next to me.
「Fuuma...... Um, could you let go of my hand now......?」
I had been so frantic that I hadn't noticed that I was still tightly gripping Shuka-senpai's hand, and hurried to let go of it.
「I'm sorry, Shuka-senpai. You were trying to help me, but I ended up pulling you in instead.」
Shuka-senpai suddenly averted her eyes, but then promptly formed a cold, senpai-ish expression.
「More importantly, this is the inside of that strange mirror, right? We have to look for a way to get out.」
「That's probably the entrance and exit over there, but......」
Told that by Hebiko, I looked back, and there was the mirror.
While exercising caution, I approached it.
「If we can touch this, we can get back...... No big deal.」
All of a sudden, a high-pitched male voice resounded.
And then, the mist formed into the shape of a person――
「To think that it would be able to artfully capture the three thorns in my side! And as a bonus, you...... are Ootori Shuka, as I recall?」
The one who had come into view was Muroi. This school's former public health doctor.
Shuka opened her eyes wide for a moment, and the next instant, she was launching a slash attack at him.
However, Muroi vanished into mist, and appeared in a different place.
Muroi-sensei――His true identity was Fürst, executive of the Nomad international crime syndicate.

He had infiltrated Gosha Academy through legitimate channels, but on the occasion of Gaiza's revolt, he had revealed his true identity and vanished, and was believed to be working with Gaiza even now.
「How'd you set a trap like this, old man?」
「Ho ho ho, what cheek! I have done no such thing! This mirror has been in Gosha from the start.」
「It would seem that while it's been left broken and neglected for these many years, a curse has taken hold of it, and it's transformed into a “Phantasmic Illusion Mirror”.」
I had read about these in a book. There was a ghost story to the effect that if you neglected a cracked mirror without giving it the proper rites, it would turn into a man-eating one.
（Gosha Academy's got tons of ninja implements and enchanted tools. It wouldn't be strange if something like that were created.）
「It was perfect, so I made just a few alterations to it, and used it as a cage to capture research subjects.」
「Fürst! How dare you do that to Kamimura-san before! Now that I've found you here, you're toast!」
「Hebiko too! She had an awful time, getting thrown in the Arena!!」
Shikanosuke's shuriken and Hebiko's octopus legs flew towards Muroi.
「Fufufu! I'm most delighted to see you're looking well!!」
However, Muroi――Fürst vanished into black mist again, and the pair's attacks whizzed through the air fruitlessly.
「It looks like that guy is an illusion.」
「He's only projecting his image here, huh?」
「But now that I've captured you, I won't be letting you out. Do play around with these shadows until you've exhausted your strength!」
The black mist changed form again, and this time, a swarm of silhouettes resembling familiar Gosha students appeared.
「That's right! Now that we know they're shadows, all that's left is to take them down straight away and get out of here!」
Shuka's blades cleaved through them, but the shadows vanished into black mist one after another, only to reappear.
The kick from Hebiko, who had transformed into an octopus, also skimmed cleanly through the Yukikaze shadow.
「It's completely useless～! What do we do, Fuuma-chan?!」
「If this is a kind of magical trap, then that mirror we came in through should be the key. I expect we can get out if we break it......」
「In that case, this won't take long!」
Shuka-senpai easily dodged the Rinko and Yukikaze shadows, and approached the mirror.
Two blades pierced into the mirror――Or so it seemed.
The mirror also turned to mist and disappeared.
Shuka promptly attacked the mirror, which had appeared in a different location, after which it disappeared again.
I suddenly looked around to see a mirror here, a mirror there――
Countless mirrors were popping up, as if mocking us.
「No, one of them must be the real thing!」
「But if there's so many, I can't tell which is which!」
I surveyed the mirrors. To be honest, I couldn't tell them apart.
「Well...... I'll think of something while we fight!」
Indeed, the mirror wasn't our only enemy. I probably wouldn't be given the luxury of thinking about it at my leisure.
「There's nothing else for it. Let's go through them, one and all!」
